description: A shell script for setting up a Python virtual environment, cloning repositories, installing requirements, and providing utility functions for logging and error handling.

methods.name: install_pip_requirements
methods.description: Installs Python requirements from a specified file, using SHA256 checksum to avoid reinstallation if unchanged.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a git repository at a specified version if not already present.

methods.name: setup_and_enable_venv
methods.description: Creates and activates a Python virtual environment if not already set up.
